---
title: "💻 Installation Guide"
---

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
*Get up and running in just a few minutes.*
:::

ADMETShiny can be installed in two ways: from **CRAN** (stable release) or from **GitHub** (development version).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 📋 Prerequisites

::: callout-tip
## Quick overview

Before installing the package, you will need: **R**, **RStudio** (recommended), **Java JDK**, and the **R dependencies**.
:::

![](images/10.png){fig-align="center"}

### Step 1 · Install R and RStudio

Download the versions that match your operating system:

| Software | Download |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| **R** | [cloud.r-project.org](https://cloud.r-project.org/) |
| **RStudio** | [posit.co/downloads](https://docs.posit.co/ide/user/#rstudio-ide-oss-downloads) |

::: callout-note
We recommend **RStudio** for its user-friendly interface.
:::

### Step 2 · Install Java (JDK)

The `rcdk` and `webchem` packages require the **Java Development Kit (JDK)**. This step is necessary to access all of ADMETShiny's features.

👉 [Java SE Development Kit Downloads (Oracle)](https://www.oracle.com/latam/java/technologies/downloads/){.btn .btn-primary}

### Step 3 · Install the dependencies

To use all of ADMETShiny's features, run the following in the R console:

``` r
# All dependencies
install.packages(c(
  "shiny", "DT", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "magrittr", "grid", "graphics",
  "utils", "grDevices", "stats", "rcdk", "webchem", "fmsb", "Rtsne",
  "ggrepel", "fingerprint", "cluster", "GGally", "openxlsx", "knitr",
  "rmarkdown", "testthat", "uwot", "viridisLite", "vegan"
))
```

::: callout-warning
## About **`testthat`**

This package is **not required** for regular users. If you would like to contribute to debugging, testing, or improving ADMETShiny, send your suggestions by [e-mail](mailto:xgarcia@unicauca.edu.co) or through the [Feedback page](https://forms.gle/83H14SnvvnrtioyE6).
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 📦 Install ADMETShiny

Choose **one** of the following options:

::: panel-tabset
## 🟢 CRAN (stable)

Recommended for most users.

``` r
install.packages("admetshiny")
```

## 🛠️ GitHub (development)

Includes the latest features and fixes.

``` r
# Install the "remotes" package
install.packages("remotes")

# Load the package
library(remotes)

# Install ADMETShiny from GitHub
remotes::install_github("xavierclementegarcia/admetshiny-package")
```
:::

::: callout-important
For the Shiny app to work correctly, you need both the **JDK** and all the **dependencies** listed above.
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 🚀 Launch ADMETShiny

``` r
# Load the package
library(admetshiny)

# Run the Shiny app
admetshiny::run_app()
```

::: callout-tip
